title: Version 17.14.17
body_markdown:
*Released October 14th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| .NET Upgrade Assistant extension is no longer compatible with Visual Studio Enterprise 17.14.36518.9 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Error-Message-when-loading-VS-20206-afte/10971375) |
| Fixed a potential crash when evaluating C++ expressions during debugging. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Division-by-zero-crash-in-msvsmonexe/10970575) |
| Copilot chat window theme conflicts with theme settings | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Configuration-of-chat-window-calls-in-Gi/10897129) |
| Using copilot to debug an exception in Android never works | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Using-copilot-to-debug-an-exception-in-A/10966692) |
| Fixed a bug with the Copilot Profiler Agent where it failed to create a BenchmarkDotNet benchmark project. |  |
| This version of .NET iOS introduces support for Apple iOS 26 and requires the use of Apple Xcode 26. For more details see [.NET for iOS/tvOS/macOS/macCatalyst release notes](https://github.com/dotnet/macios/releases) |  |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE | Descritpion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Visual Studio Information Disclosure Vulnerabilityl | [**CVE-2025-54132**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-54132) | This security update addresses Arbitrary Data Exfiltration Via Markdown Mermaidâ |
| Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-55240**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55240) | This security update addresses an Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Gulpfile |
| .NET Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-55315**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55315) | This security update addresses an HTTP Request Smuggling vulnerability due to incorrect parsing of chunk extension |
| .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-55248**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55248) | This security update addresses a vulnerability where SmtpClient may connect without TLS even if UseSsl is true |
